question: Do explicit output-structure and conservative numeric-equality evidence improve frozen S2-C candidate selection?
controls: combined minus each single evidence family
baseline: Frozen S2-C five seeds17,29,43,71,101 from interaction_consensus_20261017; mean sigmoid probabilities
OOF: fusion_confidence_20261017/results/oof-s2_consistency.npy; existing five question folds and five seeds
residual: logit(mean_seed_probability)+raw_text_features@beta; fixed baseline coefficient1, bias-free linear correction, no hard exclusion on text evidence
feature_scaling: None; binary flags, log1p counts and bounded rate; unknown arithmetic has zero evidence
objective: Sum of candidate BCE on all training OOF rows + 0.5*L2*sum(beta squared); labels are official final numeric correctness only
optimizer: Deterministic exact-gradient Newton with backtracking, zero initialization, at most80 iterations, gradient tolerance1e-7

arithmetic.support: Whole numeric sides of adjacent equalities, decimal/fraction + - * / and bounded integer powers; numeric LaTeX fractions and boxes; symbolic/units/calls/unsafe/malformed inputs unknown
arithmetic.limits: Expression240 characters, AST80 nodes, numerator/denominator256 bits, exponent abs<=8, max256 distinct pairs per candidate
arithmetic.dedup: Identical normalized equation sides counted once per candidate
arithmetic.sources: Math spans and complete plain equation lines or suffix after label colon

final_policy: Original official parser; exclude None candidates if any valid; all-invalid raw-score fallback; first index breaks ties
audit: Meaningful synthetic checks and training-only extraction coverage/label association, review seeded training examples before fitting; no tuning on the42 validation cases
evaluation: Four new process predictions with original official score script, four portable replays; paired descriptive bootstrap10000 seed20261017; full798 and active355, shared42, wrong plurality, one-correct, six flawed-correct-trace cases
validation_caveat: Repeatedly used development bank; label-free feature definitions motivated by prior validation diagnosis. Intervals descriptive; no fresh heldout generalization claim.
OOF_caveat: Base predictions are genuinely held out. Residuals fit all OOF rows; fitted training accuracy is not an unbiased cross-validation estimate of the residual model. No nested CV claim.
